slides: The alarm isn’t a command, it’s a mirror.

Your joints crave novelty more than weight.

Switch planes: squat, then row, then a kettlebell swing.
Varied vectors keep synovial fluid circulating.
Mix movement patterns weekly to preserve joint health.

When one core advances, the peripheral tasks fall into place.
Align everything to a handful of anchors for exponential progress.

Prioritize 7‑9 hours; your next PR will thank you.
